name: Prospectus analysis

subjectOf.text: The authors operationalize unconstrained status by binary coding eleven prospectus characteristics and treating a score of nine or better as unconstrained, producing a final study sample of 84 funds out of 114 funds identified in the Morningstar Nontraditional Bond index.
subjectOf.abstract: of purely unconstrained mutual funds (i.e., those which were the focus of this study) (N=84) included only those UMFs that scored a "9" or better out of a total of 114 funds identified in the Morningstar Nontraditional Bond index.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: most recent fund-level prospectuses as of the study

subjectOf.text: Unconstrained mutual funds are predominantly credit-oriented funds intended to be sold on a retail basis that nonetheless authorize the investment manager, similar to a private fund manager, to trade any type of credit security or derivative.
